name: Exp_XDPO_Histogram
summary: This EA trades based on the XDPO_Histogram custom indicator, which is a detrended price oscillator. It opens buy positions when the histogram turns upward from a declining state and sell positions when it turns downward from a rising state, implementing a mean-reversion oscillator strategy.
summary_zh: 该EA基于XDPO_Histogram自定义指标进行交易，该指标是去趋势价格振荡器。当直方图从下降状态转向上时开多仓，从上升状态转向下时开空仓，实现均值回归振荡器策略。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于去趋势价格振荡器(XDPO)，通过双重平滑处理价格数据来识别价格偏离均值的程度。入场条件：当直方图前值小于更前值（下降趋势）且当前值大于前值（开始上升）时做多；当直方图前值大于更前值（上升趋势）且当前值小于前值（开始下降）时做空。出场条件：做多信号出现时平空仓，做空信号出现时平多仓，同时设有止损和止盈。仓位管理通过MM参数和MMMode枚举控制，支持按自由保证金、余额、损失保证金、损失余额或固定手数等多种模式。资金管理使用TradeAlgorithms.mqh中封装的函数，提供灵活的资金分配方案。策略依赖两重平滑算法：第一重对价格进行平滑（默认SMA周期12），第二重对振荡器信号进行平滑（默认JJMA周期5），Phase参数控制JJMA/VIDYA/AMA的敏感度。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on the Detrended Price Oscillator (XDPO), which applies dual smoothing to price data to identify price deviations from the mean. Entry conditions: a buy is triggered when the previous histogram value is below the prior value (declining) and the current value rises above the previous value (starting to ascend); a sell is triggered when the previous value exceeds the prior value (rising) and the current value drops below the previous value (starting to descend). Exit conditions: long positions are closed when a sell signal appears and short positions are closed when a buy signal appears, complemented by configurable stop-loss and take-profit levels. Position sizing is controlled via the MM parameter and MMMode enumeration, supporting free margin, balance, loss-free-margin, loss-balance, or fixed lot modes. Money management leverages functions from TradeAlgorithms.mqh, providing flexible capital allocation schemes. The strategy relies on two layers of smoothing algorithms: the first smooths the price (default SMA period 12) and the second smooths the oscillator signal (default JJMA period 5), with Phase parameters controlling the sensitivity of JJMA/VIDYA/AMA algorithms.

pros: 双重平滑算法有效过滤噪声，信号质量较高
支持9种平滑方法和9种应用价格类型，参数灵活度高
内置止损止盈和滑点控制，具备基本风控机制
买卖开平仓可独立控制，便于策略组合和测试
使用新K线判断机制避免重复信号
pros_en: Dual smoothing algorithm effectively filters noise, providing higher quality signals
Supports 9 smoothing methods and 9 applied price types, offering high parameter flexibility
Built-in stop-loss, take-profit, and slippage control provide basic risk management
Buy/sell open and close can be independently toggled, facilitating strategy combination and testing
New bar detection mechanism prevents duplicate signals on the same bar
cons: 默认止损1000点止盈2000点过大，可能导致较大单笔亏损
缺乏仓位检查机制，未检查是否已有同方向持仓可能重复开仓
没有点差过滤，在高点差环境下振荡器策略容易受滑点影响
依赖自定义指标文件XDPO_Histogram，缺失则无法运行
SignalBar=1为默认值但在非新K线时仍可能触发交易，逻辑存在潜在重复入场风险
cons_en: Default stop-loss of 1000 and take-profit of 2000 points are excessively large, risking significant per-trade losses
Lacks position checking mechanism; no verification of existing same-direction positions may cause duplicate entries
No spread filter; oscillator-based strategies are vulnerable to slippage in high-spread environments
Depends on the custom indicator file XDPO_Histogram; missing file prevents the EA from running
SignalBar=1 is default but trading can still trigger on non-new-bar conditions, posing potential duplicate entry risk
improvements: 增加持仓检查逻辑，避免同方向重复开仓
添加点差过滤和交易时段过滤，减少不利条件下的交易
improvements_en: Add position checking logic to prevent duplicate same-direction entries
Add spread filter and trading session filter to reduce trading under unfavorable conditions

risk_points: 无持仓检查可能导致同方向重复开仓
默认止损1000点偏大，单笔风险较高
振荡器策略在趋势行情中可能持续逆势亏损
risk_points_en: No position check may lead to duplicate same-direction entries
Default 1000-point stop-loss is large, resulting in high per-trade risk
Oscillator strategy may sustain consecutive counter-trend losses during trending markets
